description.value: Mattone is a family-owned modern Italian restaurant situated at Salmon Point Resort on the Old Island Highway south of Campbell River, offering a 180-degree oceanfront view over the Salish Sea. The casual counter-service kitchen is helmed by Ryan Gark, a Chopped Canada champion, and his wife Katrina, whose Italian heritage informs dishes like Nonna's meatballs and house-made focaccia. A reviewer specifically recommends it to cyclists winding up the Old Island Highway.

address.value: 2176 Salmon Point Road, Campbell River, BC
